Container.Name: GameReplay
Container.Overview: The NAS end of LumaGame's game recorder. The TV sends the stream it is playing to port 8765; this keeps the newest minutes in a rolling buffer and writes clips and recordings to Stash/Game Recordings/[Game Name]/[date time].mp4. The buffer is the ZFS dataset endurancessd/GameReplayBuffer (8 GB quota; the service caps itself at 6 GB) and must stay on that pool: never appdata/NVMe, never the array. It is emptied when a stream ends and when the container starts. Recordings bypass the buffer and go straight to the share. Plain HTTP for the TV on the LAN port; https://gamereplay.nateshome.net shows the same status page.
Container.Requires: The dataset endurancessd/GameReplayBuffer (quota 8G) and the Stash share.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: The TV uploads here over plain HTTP (LAN only), and the status page is here.

Config.Name: Replay buffer
Config.Description: Rolling buffer. Keep it on the EnduranceSSD dataset with its quota: never appdata/NVMe, never the array.

Config.Name: Recordings
Config.Description: Where clips and recordings are filed, one folder per game.

Config.Name: BUFFER_CAP_GB
Config.Description: Hard cap of the rolling buffer in GB, whatever the TV asks. Keep it under the dataset's 8 GB quota. 6 GB holds 13 min at 65 Mbit/s and 5 min 40 s at 150 Mbit/s.

Config.Name: RECORD_MAX_MINUTES
Config.Description: Longest one recording may run, whatever the TV asks.

Config.Name: RECORD_FLOOR_GB
Config.Description: Recordings and clips are refused, and a running recording stops, when the share has less free space than this.

Config.Name: TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional bearer token. Empty: any device on the LAN may upload. Set: LumaGame's receiver address must carry it, as http://TOKEN@192.168.1.69:8765.
